selection.strategy: Five subjects with all 7 exercises x 2 quality labels x 3 camera views; choose subject IDs spread across the source list. Exclude all cross-exercise or cross-quality SHA256 conflicts and all duplicate SHA256 files.

notes: Three dataset folder organizations contain identical videos; this manifest uses only Dataset Exercise-wise.
Subject IDs may share byte-identical videos; deduplicate by SHA256 before selection.

selection.strategy: Eight videos per source label, every available subject represented; extra repetitions from source test subjects 04 and 07. GB has 7 subjects, PB and LLK have 6 (no subject 02 files).
